nom: Biore Deep Pore Charcoal Face Wash For Oily Skin

avis.titre: The Black Magic Elixir for My Face!
avis.texte: As a lover of all things that promise to make my face feel like a baby's bottom, I recently stumbled upon the Bioré Deep Pore Charcoal Face Wash. Let me tell you, this face wash is like a superhero for your skin – the Batman of face cleansers, if you will. Picture this: I'm standing in my bathroom, feeling like a mad scientist about to concoct the perfect potion for my face. With the Bioré Deep Pore Charcoal Face Wash in hand, I squeeze a little on my palm. The texture is like if silk and velvet had a baby. Smooth, luxurious, and yes, a bit mysterious – just like Batman's cape. Now, the application. I rub my hands together, and as the charcoal-infused gel transforms into a delightful frothy concoction, I can almost hear my pores sighing in relief. It's like the face wash is whispering, "I got you, pores. Let's kick some dirt and oil out of here!" The sensation on my face is refreshing, like a cool breeze on a hot summer day. The charcoal is like a magnet, attracting all the impurities and whisking them away. It's like having a mini spa day right there in my bathroom, with Batman himself ensuring the bad guys (read: blackheads) are banished. But let's talk results. My face feels as clean as a whistle – no trace of makeup, dirt, or the stress of the day. It's like a reset button for my skin. I half expect my reflection to thank me for the pampering. Now, for the cherry on top – the scent. It's not overpowering, but it's there, like a subtle hint of a luxurious cologne. It's as

avis.titre: This has been great for an annoying skin condition I have struggled with for years....
avis.texte: I picked this up on a whim when I was purchasing a new package of Biore pore strips--I had never tried any of the other products in this line, but several coupons popped up and the price of this item and a couple of others seemed so good, that I just had to try them. I have very dry skin, but it is also extremely sensitive, so I have to be careful with new products. I think I finally have the dryness under control with a whole arsenal of serums and moisturizers, but I'm still trying to find the best cleanser (or combination of cleansers) for my face. I have enlarged pores on my nose and chin and I also have that slightly dimpled skin = peau d'orange on my chin which seems to be tied to blocked glands just under the surface. I have never been able to do anything about that and just figured I was stuck with it (and I've tried dozens and dozens of products from different brands and at many price points). I was concerned about the experiences some reviewers have had regarding rashes and breakouts, so I eased into using this slowly--tried it on my forearms first, and then just a small region of my face...never any problem, so I finally worked up to using this two or three times per week. It is a little too drying for me to use it every day. I've been using this cleanser for a couple of months and I like it a lot; my skin feels very clean and fresh after using it. I pretty much focus on the lower part of my face--cheeks, nose and chin and I avoid the region around my eyes. It is th

avis.titre: Oil control, Reduced pore size, Non stripping
avis.texte: Hands down the best face wash. Been using this wash for over a year now. Have it on auto buy so I never run out. Nice light minty smell that tingles when you use it. Controls oil without over stripping your face. Luckily I have never struggled with pimples or blackheads but I do have very fair combo skin. This wash controls my oily forehead and nose but doesn't strip my dry cheeks. Three people in my house ran out of their wash and used my Biore. They loved it and all three now buy their own bottle. One does struggle with pimples and blackheads. After approx three months of use she says she has noticed a good 50% reduction of pimples and her blackheads have substantially decreased in pore size. Nothing can totally erase your pores but this wash definitely does clean them out which then decreases their size. That alone is worth giving this wash a try.

I have tried so many face washes. I have (what I assume to be) hormonal acne. I’m 48 and it’s super annoying. I have very much combination skin and couldn’t get the oily parts controlled without drying out the rest. This has been amazing and my acne is finally going away.

avis.titre: Refreshing Face Wash - Way Bigger Than Expected
avis.texte: Feels nice and cool when you wash your face, like tea tree. It’s a huge bottle so awesome deal for the price! It should last my husband and I probably about 4-6 months and we use it daily.
Works really well for removing dirt, oil, and makeup. My skin feels fresh, clean, and smooth after using it. Great for everyday use! 🖤✨
I love this face wash. I am older, but still have oily skin and large pores. I use this with a face sponge each morning and it has helped w adult acne and oil.
Works great, however it does dry my face out so I have to use a moisturizer after but it’s worth it
Si sirve raza, nomas úsenlo cada 10 días y todo chido... lo recomiendo

Questo sapone é di una freschezza unica, lascia il viso pulito senza aggredire e senza la sensazione di secco. Lascia la pelle pulita e fresca e fa piacere usarlo. Ho dovuto aspettare un bel Po, perché arriva dal Giappone e adesso compro tutto da Biore.

Es un producto que me recomendó una amiga de USA y como aquí en España no lo tenemos decidí pedirlo, y la verdad me gusta mucho... tengo la cara súper sensible a todo lo que me echo, y este producto no me da reacción y me deja la cara limpia, fresca y con una agradable sensación mentolada. No tardaré en pedir el segundo bote para asegurarme que no me falte, además me llegó rapidísimo. Genial!!

avis.titre: perfect staple into the skincare routine A Deep Clean for Your Pores
avis.texte: I have been using the Biore Deep Pore Charcoal Cleanser for a few weeks now, and I have been very impressed with it. I have noticed that my skin feels cleaner and smoother after using the cleanser. I havent seen much reduction in my pores but it does feel like its doing the clensing part. that is what i really needed it for to slip into my skincare setup as a first step to get a clean base. The cleanser is easy to use. I simply apply a small amount to my wet face and massage it in for about a 30 seconds. I then rinse it off with warm water. The cleanser has a pleasant scent and it does not leave my skin feeling dry or tight. Overall, I am very happy with the Biore Deep Pore Charcoal Cleanser. It is an effective cleanser that leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a deep-cleaning facial cleanser.

I have slightly oily skin and I'm in my 40's. I use this pretty much every day and my pores look smaller and my skin looks better than it has in years!! I love the tingly feeling that I get after using it. It makes me feel like my face is super clean. Any breakouts that I used to get, have disappeared since using this product. I have it on auto-ship now LOL!.

I’ve been using this cleanser regularly for years, and it does a great job of clearing out oil and buildup without leaving my skin overly dry. The formula has a strong, sort of minty feel that makes my skin feel clean and refreshed, and it’s been good at reducing blackheads and breakouts. It can be a bit drying if I use it too often, but when targeted or used every other day it keeps my pores nice and clear. It’s been one of the best I’ve tried.
Love it, I have oily skin and it's perfect for my face.. since I been using this product my face hasn't been oily at all. But you do have to use it every night before bed..

avis.titre: Tamper-proof tape will destroy the labeling on the bottle
avis.texte: Cleans well and is a good product all-around, but removing the tamper seal will destroy the original product’s label and make it unreadable. Just FYI.
Excelente producto muy satisfecho con mi compra feliz gracias lo estoy usando y es lo más agradable que mi rostro a probado en mucho tiempo me deja la cara fresca y con mucha suavidad
Love it, I love that it isn’t watery and that it has a functional pump I also love that it lathers well a makes my skin feel really soft.

avis.titre: I've been using it for a month
avis.texte: It feels like it really lifts away dirt and leaves my skin feeling very fresh, but even though I have oily skin, both products leave an extremely tight feeling. With continued use, my skin feels drier than usual. The cleanser has a light, easy-to-spread consistency, and the mask dries quickly without feeling heavy. It yields quite a lot, since a small amount is enough. The cleanser has a minty feel that may be uncomfortable if you have sensitive skin. It may be best to use it only a couple of times a week rather than daily. For someone with more balanced or sensitive skin, it may be too harsh.

I’ve been using this face wash for a couple of months now, and it really works. It leaves my skin feeling super clean and fresh without drying it out. I have oily skin, and this helps keep the shine down throughout the day. It has a cool, tingly feeling when you use it, which I actually like. It also removes dirt and leftover makeup really well. The bottle lasts a long time too, so it’s a good value. Definitely something I’d keep buying.

I have ordered this before with no issues but the last one I ordered came leaking and shoved into a bag. Usually I just receive the bottle on its own so it had to have been intentionally put into the bag and shipped this way.

This has worked surprisingly well for me! It smells good, lathers just enough, rinsing quickly and easily, and has helped my oil and acne issues in the few days that I’ve been using it. Be careful to not get it on your lips for long because it will dry them out (makes sense right? It dries out the oil from your face). Every time I purchase something online, I always check the reviews. I count on others to help me choose the best option. My reviews are always my honest opinion and I try to include photos if possible. If my review has helped you in any way, please click the "helpful" button below so that I know! If you have any questions feel free to ask! Thank you!
My bottle arrived damaged. Thought it may have happened during shipping but the broken part tip of the nozzle wasn’t in the box. It was shipped out like this.

This is a gel cleanser with a mild sudsing quality. The fragrance is light and pleasant and dissipate a few minutes after use. After I used it, my face felt smooth and clean. I wouldn't recommend using it to remove eye make up as it has menthol in it and it can sting, but the tingly feeling on the rest of your face is nice. It also has salicylic acid, which is good for acne. If you have dry skin, this could perhaps leave you feeling a bit tight, but for oily skin or acne problems, it is great!

avis.titre: A face cleanser with Charcoal and its benefits.
avis.texte: I really enjoy using this product! I was amazed on how clean and refreshed my face felt after usage. The cooling sensation wasn't extremely overwhelming and actually felt great after a long day in the heat. The smell is light and neutral; not too feminine or too masculine making it perfect for both genders. Then of coarse there's the amazing benefits that charcoal has on toxins our body collects daily which pushed the product over the edge for me and made it my go to choice for face cleanser. I would definitely recommend this product.

It came in the same box as my big box of rice and was dented. It came with no packaging of its own (i.e. boxed or wrapped) Not that it’s worrisome but my bottle could’ve been damaged and this product isn’t cheap. My brother-in-law uses this and let me try some. It leaves your face feeling cool and resfreshed and does wonders for clearing blackheads and reducing oily and combination skin.
Durable. Smells good. Works amazing. Easy to use. Color is black. Skin feels cleaner. Texture is thick.
Smells great, no super strong. I’ve used it twice and so far my skin is doing ok. I really wish the bottle was full when I got it.

avis.titre: If you have senstivie skin, BEWARE
avis.texte: Used this product for the first time to address some pores on my nose, but soon realized that this is really bad for sensitive skin and potentially dry skin as well. Either that, or I had an allergic reaction, but given how it seemed to dry out my skin, I think it's due to my skin type. And for the record, I followed the directions and used in on my "entire face" while avoiding eye contact. It says that it's for use on face, but thinking back it probably says a lot that the other option for this was in the form of a bar of soap. Amazon luckily provided me a refund, but I wanted to share to warn others who have sensitive skin. Anyway, if I use this brand again, I'll probably be sticking with the nose strips.

avis.titre: Leaves my skin feeling super soft to the touch
avis.texte: I’ve been using this for a few months. For reference, I have oily skin. I read the other reviews, yes this does tingle/burn if left on too long. I tend to leave it on for literally less than a minute while in shower, then rinse it off. Leaves my skin feeling super soft to the touch. It has also helped minimize my breakouts. I posted pic s below both of my results as well as the bottle which is a decent size for the price.

avis.titre: Nozzle was broken but that’s okay
avis.texte: It arrived broken, which is a bummer. We will probably just use by unscrewing the top of it to get the product out. No biggy, just inconvenient. The product itself is pretty good, it usually makes my face red after using it (I have really sensitive skin) so it’s not really for me, but it makes my boyfriends face nice and smooth when he uses it, and doesn’t cause redness for him.
Is this product genuine . Since the barcode seem to be cover with white tape on all three bottles ?

I’m a man who’s been using this product for over 3-4 years. I Use this product once when I wake up and once after showering and I always enjoy the fresh feeling you get after treating your face. I feel like if I don’t use this, my face will start to immediately break out.
I've been using this for Years. It is one of my favorite facial cleansers. It makes my skin feel so clean and soft after I use it. And it smells so fresh and clean.

If you have sensitive skin, do not buy. Even if it’s only on my face for a few minutes my face reacts like this. Which is unfortunate. I love most of this companies products. I use many of them. But this one, is not it. Don’t waste your money if you have sensitive skin.
I love this face wash. My daughter and son love it too. Too bad this last shipment was poorly wrapped and the pump broke. I transferred it to the old empty bottle of the last order.

It cleans your skin thoroughly, but I use it like a scrub, about 3x a week. It's very strong and can be harsh for my skin if I use it everyday. The smell is quite strong but it's very easy to use and you don't need much, just one pump will do. And the price is unbeatable.

I like this cleanser. It doesn't do anything amazing for my skin, however, it doesn't break out my extremely sensitive skin either. It has a pleasant smell, and foams up and removes all of my makeup very well.

avis.titre: I love this Biore Deep Pore Charcoal Cleanser
avis.texte: I love this Biore Deep Pore Charcoal Cleanser. My skin feels very clean and soft after I use this product. It came very well packaged and shipped quickly. It arrived on time as well. I recommend this product!!
Pumps smoothly. Gel like consistency. Smells good (minty). Leaves a refreshing feeling.
Been looking for an inexpensive face wash to use & hoping this would work since my creams are a little high priced. But will update after using a month. Came two days after ordering.

avis.titre: Do not buy if you have sensitive skin!!!
avis.texte: I got this product as a teenager to help me with my acne. I had clearish skin and I used this to help with the oils with my skin. It felt like it cleaned my face like crazy in a good way. I loved it but it didn't work for my skin type. It completely ruined my skin and I've been dealing with cystic dry skin and painful acne. I would not suggest using. Before and after pics of what my skin was with using this product. Before my skin was clear. After it was awful.

avis.titre: Would never recommend product! 0/10 broke out into a rash.
avis.texte: Note: this is the first time I’ve ever written an amazon review, this is how bad this product was. This cleanser made me break out into a rash like I’ve never seen before. Whole face itchy, red, bumps, dry, like never in my life. I used it for 3 days and the results kept getting worse. 2 days later, I’m still suffering from this rash. I might have to see a dermatologist soon. Wouldn’t use this again even if you paid me. 0/10 would never recommend

avis.titre: Causes cold sores, a lot of SLS
avis.texte: Horrible!!! SLS is a third ingredient so it’s choke full of it, I am allergic to SLS in toothpaste but never had a face wash affect me, the amount of SLS in this caused a giant cold sore on my lip. I immediately tossed it out, this stuff seems so natural but in reality completely toxic. Very disappointed in the brand.

avis.titre: Face broke out same day I used it. Itched bad
avis.texte: My face broke out bad after using it. It started itching so bad. I didn’t use anything else or anything different so had to be this. It has to harsh of chemicals.
But quite a bit of the product leaked out... Literally no protection in the box... Lesson learned

The ingredient list did not include salicylic acid, but when I received this item, it lists it under ingredients. I am nursing so I cannot use it. Please update the ingredient list to provide the correct information.

avis.titre: Don't buy! You'll ruin your face!!!
avis.texte: Crap! Absolute crap! Burnt and blistered my face with this terrible face cleanser! Had to get on antibiotics and prescription face ointment due to this product!

avis.titre: I have very clear skin and never have any problem ...
avis.texte: I have very clear skin and never have any problem with it. After I started using this I got small bumps all over my face. Also made my skin very dry. Never going to buy this ever again. Stay away from this product.

avis.titre: My face continued to get worse and worse
avis.texte: It left my skin red and burning after seconds of it being on. My face continued to get worse and worse.
After two uses this product caused little bumps on my skin and made my skin extremely dry and flakey! The bottle was all scratched up when it arrived too

avis.titre: Non refundable if product arrived damaged!
avis.texte: Product arrived damaged and leaking and when I went to return/replace this item in non refundable.

avis.titre: For anyone struggling with oily skin or enlarged pores, I highly recommend giving this a try!
avis.texte: I've been using Biore Deep Pore Charcoal Cleanser for several months now, and it has profoundly improved my skincare routine. This cleanser is particularly effective for my combination skin. The charcoal formula deeply cleanses, removing impurities and excess oil without over-drying my skin. I've noticed a significant reduction in blackheads and my pores appear much smaller. What I love most is the refreshing sensation it leaves after each wash, making my skin feel incredibly clean and rejuvenated. The cleanser lathers nicely and a little product goes a long way, which makes it economical. It's gentle enough for daily use and has become an indispensable part of my skincare regimen. For anyone struggling with oily skin or enlarged pores, I highly recommend giving this a try!

avis.titre: My favorite face wash! Love the tingle
avis.texte: I use this face wash every day in the shower and it is my absolute favorite that I've ever tried. It gives you this amazing little tingle in your face and when you rinse it off your skin feels so refreshed and almost "minty" is the word that comes to mind. It also has this unexplainable smell that my wife and I both love and cannot find in any other product, must be a biore trade secret or something. I have never really had any problems with acne so I cannot speak to whether this helps with that one way or the other, but I can definitely say it did not cause me to start getting any acne as I have seen some people have experienced. All in all, absolutely love the way it makes me feel, smell and look! NOTE: reading many of the other folks reviews on here, I have a strong suspicion that there is a chemical in the face wash that some people are severely allergic too. Many of the pictures I see in the other reviews appear to be allergic reactions (my wife is a dermatologist for Aveda, and she agrees). My advice would be give it a try and see what you're experience is, I have fairly normal Italian olive-tone skin and it works fantastic for me, however if you have sensitive skin it might be worth trying it on a small area first to see how you react instead of slathering it all over your face the first time. I try to review products that I use often and have very extensive experience with because I know how much I rely on other people's reviews and opinions when I make my purchases.

Ok the thing about face cleansers like this is that they work or the don’t work, depending on the type of persons skin. I don’t really have sensitive skin, as I try any type of face wash reguarlily. Like others I bought this face wash because of the charcoal fad going on. I have tried charcoal scrubs, masks, and pore strips for blackheads. When I first put this cleanser on my face, it was apparently burning. Like others I thought if it burns then it probably is removing all the gross dirt and oils. So I was scared of what would happen. Not much bad happened to me other than really dry skin which is weird for me because I have extremely oily skin. I use it once a week and use the Mario Badescu rosewater spray to help with any drying and redness. This routine works great. Just know your skin and do what’s best for it.

avis.titre: WARNING! USE AT YOUR OWN RISK
avis.texte: so I just bought this because I was trying to get rid of the remaining face pimples I had from high school. I'm a 18 year old guy. I've had acne and cleaners didn't really work. I did like he biore face mask, BUt after 2 nights of use - at morning and at night - my chin and chest have become extremely dry, and my chin has gone from 1-2 Pimples to over 30 very small zits , and it's very red. Extremely disgusting and I'm very upset this has destroyed my face overnight and I have to go to a dermatologist soon. My chest...... I workout a lot and has some pimples, but I used this product in my chest for 2 nights and this picture will explain the gravity of how awful and dangerous this product is to sensitive users who had a reaction. .... View at your own caution and realize this could become u
It burned my face!! I've never write reviews but this is important! Don't use it in sensitive skin!!

Please, please, please DO NOT BUY this facial cleanser!!!! I read an article about this cleanser being one of the best facial beauty cleansers of the year, so I decided to give it a try (Especially with all the hype about charcoal lately). The first day I used it, it really stung, but just like everyone else I figured it was the cleanser working. The second time I used it (at night) it stung even more, but I figured it was still okay, but by the next day when I woke up my chin was itchy and sore. As the day went by I started to develop small bumps all over my my cheeks and chin plus a chemical burn on my chin. Now I have huge amounts of anxiety over whether this will go away and if my skin will go back to normal :( I don't use facial cleansers very often and I am just horrified that this first time I used it, it completely messed up my face

Feels amazing, like tea tree shampoo for your face. You can feel it tingling like tea tree, which means it’s pulling the impurities out of your face, like charcoal should do. As a guy my skins not super sensitive that’s all I would worry about if you have super sensitive skin it could have an adverse effect it’s pretty strong which is what you want out of a charcoal face cleanser. It’s been great for me exactly what I was looking for out of a face cleanser my face looks younger and definitely noticed less breakouts. I don’t leave reviews unless something is really good or really bad this falls into the really good category.

avis.titre: Caused severe acne ad allergic reaction
avis.texte: I had a perfectly clear face before I used this charcoal cleanser. Overnight I developed an itchy rash that soon turned into an EXTREMELY bad acne breakout. I have never had acne, just the occasional pimple and now I'm covered in red bumps and pimples. DO NOT USE THIS STUFF! It doesn't even seem like it has charcoal in it and it's just that slimy run of the mill drug store face wash with those stupid little beads in it.

Pretty amazing face soap! I was my face with it every night, and I definitely FEEL clean. Only thing is, it doesn't seem to help much with my acne. If you have severe acne I would not reccomend this product. However, light acne shouldn't be a problem. Also, not much of a makeup remover. Beware of black dots in the sink!

avis.titre: Horrible! Burned my face and I now have acne
avis.texte: Absolutely horrible! The first night I used it I loved the way my face looked and felt. I woke up and used it again and before bed. When I woke up on the third day my face was covered in white heads and burned where I concentrated on cleaning the most, my cheeks/nose and chin. I will never use this product again I should have listened to the other reviewers.

Afyer reading the reviews I had to write one myself. I have sensitive skin as well and pale. Like it says it literally cleans your pores out and will leave your skin feeling dry, but hello that's where the moisturizer comes in. Your alwaus suppose to use a moisturizer after washing to keep the balance. I personally use Neutrogena hydro boost water gel and my oh my these two are awesome. I recommend both products.

This cleanser made my face so dry and red. My cheeks are on fire. It's a tingling, burning sensation that can only be relieved by taking Aleve and putting an ice pack on my skin. The picture included was taken one hour after using this product. No other topicals were used (no interaction).

Although I read mixed reviews about this product, I still decided to try it due to the high rating. I've tried the product two times. The first night I used the product let me just say they aren't lying when they say it burns. I've used many face washes where I've felt tingling sensations but none like this. I figured the burning sensation meant it was really cleaning my pores, instead it really irritated my skin, left me with little bumps & an itchy face.
Me gusta este producto, llego antes de tiempo que es perfecto.

avis.titre: BEWARE: DESCRIPTION IS FOR "JERGEN'S NATURAL GLOW" (WTF??)
avis.texte: Uuuum...why exactly is your description describing "Jergen's Natural Glow" self tanning lotion? I haven't even purchased this product from here, just an observation. But this sounds pretty DECEIVING, if you ask me! Considering that the reviews look pretty terrible, you may not be receiving the product that's advertised here.

avis.titre: Causes break out and inflamed skin!
avis.texte: I usually use the Biore Pore Unclogging scrub and have used it over a year, no problem. I thought I would give the charcoal cleanser a try. When applied you get this tingling sensation, and I thought it was working it’s magic. Wrong. After a second use my skin broke out, was inflamed, and had red splotches all over my forehead. I have great skin and now I have acne to a degree I’ve never had before. The picture is from two days after I used it. I haven’t used any product on it since and it still looks that horrible.

avis.titre: PLEASE DO NOT BUY THIS PRODUCT.
avis.texte: Why does this have 4 stars?!?! Though I bought this from Walmart, I wanted to also review it on amazon to tell people, DO NOT BUY THIS PRODUCT. I used this 3 nights ago, read the instructions which were pretty basic, for my oily skin. The first night my face kind of stung but I said wow, my face is soft and yeah it stings a bit but it’s probably because it’s very clean. The next morning I woke up to a red, painful, swollen rash everywhere I applied the product. You would think that it’d still better overtime but it is now day three with this painful bumpy face and it BURNS even more now. The skin around the corners of my lips are splitting whenever I talk or smile, I have chemical burns on my cheeks, and every couple of hours my skin flares into a red stinging burning mess. Everywhere where I didnt apply this foul product is completely fine. My cheeks, nose, and chin haven’t been able to make any new oils, as my skin is splitting from the dryness. The only thing that soothes it is coconut oil during work hours, and cold compresses during the night. I honestly don’t know how the hell this is still on the market. It’s been a very painful experience and all I can hope is that my skin doesn’t stay this bumpy forever. Thanks for the chemical burns biore. BTW the pictures are taken with coconut oil and Vaseline covering my skin. This is the only way I can get through the day with only minor splitting. Mind you again, this is the THIRD a day after initial use. Ridiculous.

Do not buy this product especially if you have sensitive skin. It will cause reaction. My skin is ALWAYS clear and I used this one time and my face broke out in many many little bumps, was rough, burning . Even if it doesn’t cause a reaction to you the first time or first few times doesn’t mean it’s not causing long term damage to your skin. This product overall is NOT GOOD.

avis.titre: Great facial cleanser for sensitive skin!
avis.texte: The Biore charcoal cleanser is a gentle yet powerful facial cleansing product that does not dry out or irritate my skin. I am able to use this on my face daily and love the way it leaves my skin feeling fresh and clean. The results are obvious as you see the improvement in your skin if you suffer from oily skin or blackheads.

avis.titre: ... actually bought this exact cleanser at Walmart and had horrible results from it
avis.texte: I actually bought this exact cleanser at Walmart and had horrible results from it. After only 2 uses I had a horrible break out. I have very sensitive skin and it is normally clear with an occasional pimple either on my neck or face and this cleanser ruined both areas. Maybe it was an allergic reaction, but now I'm trying to clear it up the best I can. Posted are the results I got. So much for clear and radiant skin Biore...

Have used this 3 times. The first time everything was ok. I noticed my skin was a bit dry after, and I noticed a few small red raised dots. I thought it was my period on the way (my skin always gets a bit spotty before my monthlys) and didn't think it was anything to do with the product. the second time I used it my skin was extremely dry after and very tight. Also very red. The third time, which is now, my face feels like I have a severe sun burn. It's extremely hot to the touch and very angry and red. I have small red spots everywhere where the product touched. You can see on the pictures my eye area is totally fine because I didn't get any of the product there. My face hurts so much. Don't buy this stuff, it's really really harsh.

avis.titre: Save your money, and your skin . Ouch.
avis.texte: This cleanser tingled and burned more than any other I’ve tried . I didn’t keep it on for an extended amount of time , don’t have super sensitive skin , and am not taking or anything else that could cause an interaction. My face is so red, splotchy, and swollen that it feels like I have a bad sunburn . DO NOT RECOMMEND.

I used this product for about a week without any problem. I did feel a tingle on my skin when I used it, but I figured it was supposed to do that. After about 5 days I noticed some itching sensations on my chin, but assumed I just had some killer hormonal acne coming in. Turns out, I was developing a rash that is most likely an allergic reaction to this product (This was the only new product I had used in the last few weeks). Now I have a couple not-so-cute rashy patches on my chin and near the corners of my mouth. (I know its hard to see in the photo. Trust me, it's there and it's uncomfortable as hell. I took benadryl to lessen the redness and itch) The patches are very dry, bumpy, and itchy. I've never experienced a reation to any other face products before, and I don't have sensitive skin. Don't risk it with this stuff.

avis.titre: Contains charcoal powder for natural purification and salicylic acid for acne
avis.texte: This product is excellent. It keeps my adult acne at bay. I am in my 40s for reference. The charcoal powder acts as a natural purification while the salicylic acid works to reduce appearance of acne and prevent breakouts. I find the cooling tingling sensation that comes after applying it refreshing. You must be careful to not use it around your eyes however, because of this feature. I find that it deep cleans but doesn’t strip the skin of natural moisture, or leave it oily with residue. The scent can be a bit strong when applying but washes away with water. I have used the majority of products on the market in terms of facial cleansers and I always come back to this one.

avis.titre: This is not the same product shown in the photos
avis.texte: I did not receive the product shown in the listing photo. Instead, I was sent "Biore Charcoal - Oil Control." At first glance, this might seem similar to the original Biore Charcoal face wash, but it is not the same. The oil control version has a completely different formula, and whatever ingredients they use give it a terrible smell. It’s an unpleasant, chemical-like odor that I can’t quite identify, but it’s incredibly off-putting. I absolutely dislike this version of the charcoal face wash and deliberately avoided buying it. Unfortunately, I feel like I wasted my money since I refuse to use this product. I’m also disappointed that Biore seems to have replaced their original formula with this new one. The old version is getting harder to find, which makes this situation even more frustrating. This seller should change their product photo to reflect what they are actually selling.
